quality_highlights.aspect: Clear narrative structure; specific technical metrics (token counts, turn counts, file counts); well-balanced technical and business context.

TestSafeOutputsTargetValidation_InvalidEvent validates four distinct user-facing error message qualities: problem phrase, field name, bad value, and valid suggestion. Lines 45-55 enforce error helpfulness directly.

When to Use section (line 11) is a dense comma-separated prose sentence listing four use cases. Should be a bulleted list for faster scanning. Parenthetical '(monorepo alternative)' buried mid-sentence.
